title: Every transform handle answers the pointer before you click
goal: Any handle that transforms an object (move, resize corners and edges, rotate, the 3D tilt arcs and depth control, pivot, crop edges, path points, zoom box, measure feet) should show, as the pointer comes over it, that a press will grab it: the handle brightens or grows, the 3D arc lights in its axis colour, and the cursor changes to say what will happen. Today the 3D controls give no sign at all until you drag, so the person cannot tell whether they are on them.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "also the transform options for 3d don't have any hover feedback so i don't know that i'm selecting them. I think the tools for transforming an object should have hover feedback so i know if I click they are going to do something."

From code reading (not run): the 3D handles in Sources/Photonz/CanvasSpaceHandles.swift only set a closed hand cursor once a drag starts (:237) and refresh the grab cursor on release (:264); no hover highlight. Other handles use refreshGrabCursor / applyGrabCursor (cursor only). Design reference: the 2.5D mock docs/design/mocks/pages/video-depth.html (option A 'arcs grow when the pointer rests on them', generous hit area). Memory: legible text in every state.
acceptance: Inventory first, written in the audit: every on-canvas handle in the app at Next defaults and what it does today on hover (cursor, highlight, nothing)

One shared hover treatment for handles, used by all of them: within the handle's hit area (which may be larger than its drawing) the handle shows a hover state (for example a brighter fill and a 1.25x scale, or an outline glow for arcs) within one frame, and the cursor changes to the right macOS cursor for the action (resize arrows by direction and turned to the layer's rotation, a rotate cursor, an open hand for move, crosshair where appropriate)
The 3D arcs: the arc under the pointer lights in its axis colour and thickens, and a small label (Tilt X, Tilt Y, Depth) appears next to the pointer after a short rest; the other arcs dim slightly
Hovering never changes the document and never takes key; it costs nothing measurable in canvas frame time (MEASURED)
Hit areas and drawings agree: a hover highlight means a press there grabs that handle, checked for every handle in the inventory by a walk or test that hovers then presses
Text and icons in any hover label stay legible over light and dark pictures
A walk hovers each handle on a picked layer (including the 3D arcs) and photographs the hover state for each
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: the cursor side already existed for most handles (CanvasPointer cue mirrors the press); the gap was a visible highlight. Chose one shared mark registry keyed by the drawing layer so a hidden layer's handles never light, and let the cue decide which mark lights, so hover can never promise a different handle than the press takes. 3D arc names use the panel's words (Rotation Y/X, Depth), not the task's Tilt X/Y example.

Found: on a layer turned in 3D the resize squares and corner dots are drawn on the turned card but a press there takes nothing (cue 'none'); filed resize-squares-on-a-layer-turned-in-3d-take-the (p2, reproduced by the walk).

left rough, not filed: canvas edge handles, caliper feet, motion pivot and motion path squares light through the same code but no walk rests on them (a caliper would not draw on a blank picture in a walk); the 3D handles keep the open-hand cursor; a layer body keeps the plain arrow because the open hand on a screen's surface is what tells carry from sweep. Full suite: 12793 tests green on one run; a later run had one render timing test at 16.39ms vs 16ms (TextDepthPerspectiveTests), green alone, untouched by this change.

Shipped in 19001c56: every transform handle lights under the resting pointer (quarter larger, accent fill, glow) via one shared treatment, HandleHover (PhotonzCore, 8 tests) + CanvasHandleHover; the pointer cue decides which mark lights so it is always the handle a press takes. 3D arcs/depth arrow thicken in their colour, others dim, and name themselves (Rotation Y/X, Depth) after 0.35s. Zoom box corners lit by the box overlay. Verified: new walk every-handle-lights-on-hover-walk (rectangle 16 handles incl. 3D, turned card, arrow, crop, pen path; 31 real captures) and framing-a-zoom-shows-one-box-walk at Next defaults, both green; 8 related walks green; full suite green. Hover cost measured 0.001-0.01ms per move. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-12-handle-hover.json. Follow-up: resize-squares-on-a-layer-turned-in-3d-take-the.
